source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, recruiting interventional studies
note: Criteria text is quoted from each registry entry. Rules were compiled from that public text; criteria the registry marks as 'further criteria apply' are not covered.

trials.title: Elecoglipron alone or with dapagliflozin vs placebo in adults with type 2 diabetes

criteria.text: Diagnosed with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) for at least 90 days prior to screening
T2DM inadequately managed with lifestyle management alone or on stable treatment with other background glucose-lowering medication
criteria.ask: Have your diabetes medicines and doses stayed the same for at least the last 3 months (or do you take no diabetes medicines)?

criteria.text: HbA1c value of ≥ 7% to ≤ 10.5% (53 to 91.3 mmol/mol)
Body mass index (BMI) of ≥ 23 kg/m2 at screening
Stable body weight (self-reported or documented) for 90 days prior to screening

rule.assumption: Stable taken as a change of 5% or less

criteria.ask: Has your weight stayed roughly the same (within about 5%) over the last 3 months?

criteria.text: Type 1 diabetes, secondary forms of diabetes (including congenital forms), or history of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar coma

rules.statement: The patient has type 1 diabetes, a secondary form of diabetes, or a history of diabetic ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar coma.

criteria.ask: Have you ever been told you have type 1 diabetes, or been treated for diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA)?

criteria.text: Currently receiving or anticipated to receive, therapeutic intervention for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema

rule.statement: The patient is receiving or expected to receive treatment for diabetic retinopathy or macular edema.

criteria.ask: Are you being treated, or about to be treated, for diabetic eye disease (retinopathy or macular edema)?

criteria.text: Have had more than one episode of severe hypoglycemia within 180 days prior to screening or has a history of hypoglycemia unawareness or poor recognition of hypoglycemic symptoms

rule.statement: The patient had more than one severe hypoglycemia episode in the last 6 months, or has hypoglycemia unawareness.

criteria.ask: In the last 6 months, have you had more than one severe low blood sugar episode, or do you often not notice when your blood sugar is low?

criteria.text: Clinically significant condition affecting the upper GI tract or chronic use of any medication that affects gastric motility or gastric emptying

rule.statement: The patient has a significant upper gastrointestinal condition or chronically takes a medicine that affects stomach emptying.

criteria.ask: Do you have a significant stomach or oesophagus condition, or regularly take medicine that affects stomach emptying?

criteria.text: History of acute or chronic pancreatitis

rules.statement: The patient has a history of pancreatitis.

criteria.ask: Have you ever had pancreatitis?

criteria.text: Severe congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association IV)

rule.statement: The patient has severe heart failure (NYHA class IV).

criteria.ask: Have you been diagnosed with severe heart failure?

criteria.text: History/family history of medullary thyroid cancer or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2

rule.statement: The patient or a family member has had medullary thyroid cancer or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 (MEN2).

criteria.ask: Have you or anyone in your family had medullary thyroid cancer or MEN2?

trials.title: Different doses of UBT251 to lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes

criteria.text: Age 18-75 years (both inclusive) at the time of signing the informed consent.
Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes greater than or equal to (≥) 180 days before screening.
Stable daily dose(s) ≥ 90 days before screening of metformin with or without sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor.
HbA1c of 7.0-10.5 percent (%) (both inclusive) as assessed by central laboratory at screening.
Body mass index between 25.0 kg/m^2 and 50.0 kg/m^2 (both inclusive) at screening.
Treatment with any medication for the indication of diabetes or obesity other than stated in the inclusion criteria within 90 days before screening.

rule.label: Insulin, GLP-1, DPP-4, sulfonylurea or TZD

criteria.text: Uncontrolled and potentially unstable diabetic retinopathy or maculopathy, verified by an eye examination within 90 days before screening.
Known hypoglycaemic unawareness as indicated by the investigator according to Clarke's questionnaire, question 8.

trials.title: ALN-ANG3 in adults with diabetic kidney disease

criteria.text: Age 18 to 80 years
Medical history of type 2 diabetes and receiving medical therapy or lifestyle interventions for glucose management
Hemoglobin A1C (HbA1c) of 6.5 to 10% at screening
eGFR 30 to 90 mL/min/1.73 m^2 (CKD-EPI eGFRcr-cys equation) at screening

rule.label: eGFR
rule.assumption: Record eGFR may use a different equation; site recomputes with creatinine and cystatin C

criteria.text: Albuminuria: Urine Albumin to Creatinine Ratio (UACR) of 500 to 5000 mg/g at screening
Known medical history or clinical evidence indicative of non-diabetic renal disease

rule.statement: The patient has kidney disease that is not caused by diabetes.

criteria.ask: Has a doctor told you your kidney disease has a cause other than diabetes?

criteria.text: Renal disease that required systemic immunosuppressive therapy, or end-stage kidney disease requiring chronic dialysis or kidney transplantation

rules.statement: The patient is on dialysis, has had a kidney transplant, or received immunosuppressive therapy for kidney disease.

criteria.ask: Are you on dialysis, have you had a kidney transplant, or been given immune-suppressing treatment for your kidneys?

criteria.text: Medically unstable as assessed by the investigator or hospitalization (>24 hours) within 30 days of the screening visit
criteria.ask: Have you stayed in hospital overnight in the last 30 days?

trials.title: Berobenatide (PF-08653944) in people with overweight or obesity

criteria.text: Aged ≥18 years.
BMI of ≥30 kg/m2, or ≥27.0 to <30.0 kg/m2 with at least 1 weight-related co-morbidity: hypertension, dyslipidemia, obstructive sleep apnea, cardiovascular disease, or T2D.

rules.label: Hypertension, dyslipidemia, sleep apnea, CVD or T2D

criteria.text: Self-reported body weight change greater than 5% within 90 days prior to Screening.
criteria.ask: Has your weight changed by more than 5% in the last 3 months?

criteria.text: Diagnosis of type 1 diabetes or any other form of diabetes other than T2D.
History of acute or chronic pancreatitis.

rules.statement: The patient has a history of pancreatitis.

criteria.ask: Have you ever had pancreatitis?

criteria.text: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 (MEN-2).

rule.statement: The patient or a family member has had medullary thyroid cancer or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 (MEN2).

criteria.ask: Have you or anyone in your family had medullary thyroid cancer or MEN2?

trials.title: Home self-administration of maridebart cafraglutide with an autoinjector in obesity or overweight

criteria.text: Age 18 to 99 years
BMI ≥ 30 kg/m^2, or BMI ≥ 27 to < 30 kg/m^2 with hypertension, dyslipidemia, obstructive sleep apnea, cardiovascular disease or fatty liver disease

rules.label: Hypertension, dyslipidemia, sleep apnea, CVD or fatty liver

criteria.text: At least 1 unsuccessful attempt at weight loss by diet and exercise.

rule.statement: The patient has tried to lose weight with diet or exercise without lasting success.

criteria.ask: Have you tried to lose weight with diet and exercise before, without lasting success?

criteria.text: Contraception for females.
criteria.ask: If you could become pregnant, are you willing to use contraception during the trial?

criteria.text: Willingness to follow trial procedures for the duration of the trial.
Obesity induced by other endocrinologic disorders.

rule.statement: The patient's obesity is caused by an endocrine disorder.

criteria.ask: Has a doctor said your weight is caused by a hormone condition (for example thyroid or Cushing's)?

criteria.text: Change in body weight > 5 kg within last 90 days.
criteria.ask: Has your weight changed by more than 5 kg in the last 3 months?

criteria.text: Previous or planned surgical, endoscopic, or device-based treatment for obesity.

rule.statement: The patient has had or is planning weight-loss surgery, an endoscopic procedure or a weight-loss device.

criteria.ask: Have you had, or are you planning, weight-loss surgery or a weight-loss device?

criteria.text: History of malignancy within the past 5 years.

rule.statement: The patient has had cancer in the past 5 years.

criteria.ask: Have you been diagnosed with or treated for cancer in the past 5 years?

criteria.text: Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
History of chronic pancreatitis or history of acute pancreatitis within last 180 days.

rules.statement: The patient has a history of pancreatitis.

criteria.ask: Have you ever had pancreatitis?

criteria.text: Family or personal history of medullary thyroid cancer.

rule.statement: The patient or a family member has had medullary thyroid cancer.

criteria.ask: Have you or anyone in your family had medullary thyroid cancer?

criteria.text: Previous participation in a Maridebart Cafraglutide trial.
criteria.ask: Have you taken part in a maridebart cafraglutide (MariTide) trial before?
